biomes.description: Dense, toxic fumes from deep within the planet's crust seep out of cracks in the earth and coat the ground in a sickly haze.
hazards: Thin fog clings to the ground
Occasional water/acid springs, harmless, though they slow down any Helldivers deciding to take a bath
Slowing Ferns are often present near rock formations
biomes.name: Acidic Badlands

hazards: Large concrete cutouts full of Lava can be found across the surface. Stepping on them will deal damage and set the Helldiver on Fire.
Occasional spills of Acid can be found on the ground. Stepping on them will deal damage over time.
Tar slicks occasionally cover the floor near structures, particularly around Lava pools. Stepping on them slows down Helldivers and enemies.
Ventilation systems that release steam can be found across most buildings. Staying near them upon steam release will deal minor damage and knock Helldiver down.
biomes.name: Automaton Megafactory

biomes.description: No description given.
biomes.name: Autumn Forest

biomes.description: Tall, gnarled trees flourish across the surface of this forested world. Sunlight filters past dangling vines, to the saturated undergrowth below.
hazards: Volcano Plants explode into fire when damaged.
Tall Grass and Ferns slowing any Helldivers walking through it down.
Deep water that causes any Helldiver taking a swim to drown, along with large rivers that often cut through the mission area.
biomes.name: Basic Swamp

biomes.description: No description given.
hazards: Slowing Ferns, which slow any Helldiver passing through them down.
Even though most of the water found is either shin- or knee-deep, occasional deep pits of water can still be found (especially on explosion sites), which can...
biomes.name: Bleak Oasis

biomes.description: Ice and moss-covered rock can be found across most of the surface of this planet.
hazards: Frost Flowers that will produce a mist that slows any Helldiver inside if damaged.
Deep water, where if the Helldiver decides to take a swim and does not leave the water in time, they will drown.
biomes.name: Boneyard

biomes.description: No description given.
biomes.name: Crimson Forest

biomes.description: Cyberstan, once again, forms the axis of the Cyborg Legion's insurrection. Massive Megafactories cover its surface, churning out mechanical armies and weapons of mass extinction.
hazards: Frost Flowers that will produce a mist that slows anything inside if damaged or touched.
Large concrete cutouts full of Lava can be found inside the Megafactories. Stepping on them will deal damage and set the Helldiver on Fire.
Occasional spills of Acid can be found on the ground inside the Megafactories. Stepping on them will deal damage overtime.
Tar slicks occasionally cover the floor near structures, particularly around Lava pools in the Megafactories. Stepping on them slows down Helldivers and...
biomes.name: Cyberstan Megafactory

biomes.description: The lifeless grey of this planet is interrupted only by the violet flowers that grow from strange, parasitic outcroppings.
hazards: The deadlands feature Spike Plants and Lava Pits.
The deadlands also have a hidden trait; unmarked Damaged Hellbombs may appear in any difficulty. In any other biome, this feature is limited to Challenging (4)...
biomes.name: Deadlands

biomes.description: No description given.
biomes.name: Deciduous Forest

conditions: Intense Heat does not occur at night.
biomes.description: A desert planet prone to unpredictable and dangerous sand twisters.
hazards: Occasional misty springs, harmless, though they slow down any Helldivers deciding to take a bath
Tall dead Ferns, slowing any creatures walking through down
biomes.name: Desert Cliffs

biomes.description: A blazing-hot desert planet, its rocky mesas are the sole interruptions to the endless sea of dunes.
hazards: Occasional misty springs, harmless, though they slow down any Helldivers deciding to take a bath
Tall dead Ferns, slowing any creatures walking through down
biomes.name: Desert Dunes

biomes.description: No description given.
hazards: Slowing Ferns, which slow any Helldiver passing through them down.
Even though most of the water found is either shin- or knee-deep, occasional deep pits of water can still be found (especially on explosion sites), which can...
biomes.name: Desert Oasis

biomes.description: This world teems with ethereal, boundless, and peculiar plant life that spreads silent and uninterrupted across its entire surface.
hazards: Spike Plants that will explode into tiny pieces much like the G-6 Frag grenade, if it takes any damage.
Lava Pits will kill any Helldiver unlucky enough to fall inside.
Slowing ferns can also commonly be found across the surface, especially near rock formations and in denser jungles.
biomes.name: Ethereal Jungle

biomes.description: Squelching mud, twisting roots; the odor of rot and anarchy. A teeming, endless morass.
hazards: Volcano Plants explode into fire when damaged.
Large walls of rocks usually spanning a couple hundred meters may require a detour to move past.
biomes.name: Haunted Swamp

conditions: Gloom Source: This planet continually produces a thick atmospheric Gloom cover, rendering logistical support extremely challenging. Total Reinforcements are...
Roving Shriekers: Flying Shrieker swarms traverse the battlefield. (always present in difficulty Hard (5) and up)
biomes.description: This planet has been completely infested by the Terminids, transformed inside and out into a hive of Tyranny.
hazards: Hive Worlds feature underground caves, which are too durable for Hellpods to penetrate, stopping Stratagems from dropping in.
Underground caves can also have ravines and pitfalls, with only an organic bridge to cross them.
Bug Mines are present throughout the surface and deep into the underground caves.
biomes.name: Hive World

biomes.description: Submerged in eternal winter, this world's frosty peaks glimmer in the light of its too-distant star.
hazards: Frost Flowers will explode into a mist that slows any Helldiver or Enemy inside if damaged.
Slippery Ice reduces the friction of the ground, negatively impacting driving while on the ice.
Water deep enough to drown a careless Helldiver.
biomes.name: Icy Glaciers

biomes.description: A crimson algae has propagated wildly across this entire planet, coating its rocky hills with a constant red that masks the spilt blood of the heroes who defend it from tyranny.
hazards: Smoke Shrooms will explode into a brown smoke if damaged.
Deep pits of mud slow down Helldivers trying to move through.
Tall Jagged Cliffs usually line the edges of the mission area and any Helldiver unlucky enough to fall off will instantly die.
biomes.name: Ionic Crimson

biomes.description: The strange subversion of photosynthesis that sustains the oddly-hued flora that flourishes on this planet remains an intriguing mystery to Super Earth's greatest exo-biologists.
hazards: Spike Plants that will explode into tiny pieces much like the G-6 Frag grenade, if it takes any damage.
Lava Pits will kill any Helldiver unlucky enough to fall inside.
Slowing ferns can also commonly be found across the surface, especially near rock formations and in denser jungles.
biomes.name: Ionic Jungle

biomes.description: Constant eruptions keep this planet covered in lava flows and utterly inhospitable to Democratic life. It also makes it a treasure trove of rare minerals.
hazards: Lava lakes, rivers, and pockets ignite anything flammable and deal extra damage when standing on it for prolonged periods of time.
Lava Geysers periodically explode, creating a shockwave that launches any Helldivers that stand too close into the air, before spurting out lava and igniting...
Grey Cacti which slowly drain your health when touched.
Tall grass which slow any Helldivers passing through down.
biomes.name: Magma Desert

biomes.description: A rocky, lonely moon with extremely valuable mineral deposits underneath the surface.
hazards: Occasional misty springs, harmless, though they slow down any Helldivers deciding to take a bath
Tall dead Ferns, slowing any creatures walking through down
biomes.name: Moon

biomes.description: Rocky outcroppings punctuate fields of tall grass in a planet dominated by misty highland terrain.
hazards: Smoke Shrooms will explode into a brown smoke if damaged.
Deep pits of mud slow down Helldivers trying to move through.
Tall Jagged Cliffs usually line the edges of the mission area and any Helldiver unlucky enough to fall off will instantly die.
biomes.name: Plains

biomes.description: This arid, rocky biome covering this world has driven the evolution of exceptionally efficient water usage in its various organisms.
hazards: Occasional misty springs, harmless, though they slow down any Helldivers deciding to take a bath.
Slowing Ferns are often present near rock formations.
biomes.name: Rocky Canyons

biomes.description: Scorching temperatures, high winds, and low precipitation cause a near-constant cycle of fires to sweep this planet, punctuated by short bursts of lush rebirth between infernos.
hazards: Smoke Shrooms will explode into a brown smoke if damaged.
Deep pits of mud slow down Helldivers trying to move through.
biomes.name: Scorched Moor

biomes.description: The blinding beacon that illuminates the stars with the light of Democracy. The patriotic paradise for citizens who truly serve their Federation. And the utopian future awaiting the entire galaxy.
biomes.name: Super Earth Metropolis

biomes.description: Entirely unforeseeable mutations from the Termicide led to hyper-accelerated bug growth on this planet, turning it into a Supercolony. It is corrupted beyond saving. The bugs infest every inch of it, down to the mantle, spawning trillions of spores every day.
hazards: Spike Plants are present in the patches of the surface that still consist of the original Volcanic Jungle.
Tall grass and slowing ferns are also present in those areas.
Bug Mines are scattered across the surface, growing from the Terminid matter.
biomes.name: Supercolony

biomes.description: A perennially chilly climate has allowed short, colorful shrubs to flourish across this planet's surface.
hazards: Smoke Shrooms will explode into a brown smoke if damaged.
Deep pits of mud slow down Helldivers trying to move through.
Tall Jagged Cliffs usually line the edges of the mission area and any Helldiver unlucky enough to fall off will instantly die.
Water can also be a threat for any Helldiver deciding to take a swim.
biomes.name: Tundra

biomes.description: No description given.
biomes.name: Void Forest

biomes.description: Abundant with life, this wet planet is covered in deep oceans, thick forests, and tall grasses.
hazards: Spike Plants that will explode into tiny pieces much like the G-6 Frag grenade, if it takes any damage.
Lava Pits will kill any Helldiver unlucky enough to fall inside.
Slowing ferns can also commonly be found across the surface, especially near rock formations and in denser jungles.
biomes.name: Volcanic Jungle

description: Curated world intel: biomes, planets, missions, difficulty levels and mission effects.

difficulty.name: Trivial
difficulty.role: Difficulty level 1. Map size is set to 250-meter radius (~0.196 km²)

difficulty.name: Easy
difficulty.role: Difficulty level 2. Map size increased to 300-meter radius (~0.283 km²) / Introduces Optional Objectives Introduces enemy spawn zones/Outposts in the form of Bug Nests/Automaton Outposts/Illuminate Encampments

difficulty.name: Medium
difficulty.role: Difficulty level 3. Map size increased to 350-meter radius (~0.385 km² surface-area) 1 neutral (e.g., Radar Station) or timed (e.g., Intercept Convoy) Optional Objective is revealed on the map from the mission screen Introduces Medium Outposts

difficulty.name: Challenging
difficulty.role: Difficulty level 4. Map size increased to 400-meter radius (~0.503 km² surface-area) Introduces Rare Samples Enemies can now occupy Minor Places of Interest (mPOIs) Introduces Unmarked Damaged Hellbombs (except Deadlands biome which has them at all difficulties) Introduces Heavy Outposts Rare samples first appear.

difficulty.name: Hard
difficulty.role: Difficulty level 5. Introduces Operation Modifiers One Operation Modifier is added.

difficulty.name: Extreme
difficulty.role: Difficulty level 6. Introduces Super Samples Super samples first appear.

difficulty.name: Suicide Mission
difficulty.role: Difficulty level 7. Most mPOIs are now enemy faction themed. For example, mPOIs on the Automaton front may have the main structure replaced with a Cannon Turret tower, or have their entrances blocked by fences and mines.

difficulty.name: Impossible
difficulty.role: Difficulty level 8. Adds a second Operation Modifier A second Operation Modifier is added.

effects.name: Atmospheric Spores
effects.role: Atmospheric Spores is an Operation Modifier, exclusive to the Terminid front.

effects.name: Civilians and SEAF in Area

effects.name: Complex Stratagem Plotting
effects.role: Complex Stratagem Plotting is an Operation Modifier in Helldivers 2.

effects.name: Electronic Countermeasures
effects.role: Electronic Countermeasures was an Operation Modifier in Helldivers 2.

effects.name: Gunship Patrols
effects.role: Gunship Patrols is an Operation Modifier in Helldivers 2. This modifier impacts all missions within the operation.

effects.name: Leviathan Blockade
effects.role: Leviathan Blockade is an Operation Modifier in Helldivers 2. This modifier impacts all operations taken on Super Earth during the Battle for Super Earth starting on Hard difficulty. This was later changed to Impossible difficulty. After the Battle for Super...

effects.name: Orbital Fluctuations
effects.role: Orbital Fluctuations is an Operation Modifier in Helldivers 2.

effects.name: Poor Intel
effects.role: Poor Intel is an Operation Modifier in Helldivers 2 exclusive to the Automaton front.

effects.name: Roving Shriekers
effects.role: Roving Shriekers is an Operation Modifier in Helldivers 2. This modifier impacts all missions within the operation.

effects.name: Acid Storms
effects.role: Acid Storms – Corrosive acid storms temporarily reduce armor effectiveness for both enemy and friendly units.

effects.name: Blizzards
effects.role: Blizzards – Intense blizzards reduce mobility and moderately reduce visibility for both enemy and friendly units.

effects.name: Extreme Cold
effects.role: Extreme Cold – Periods of freezing temperatures reduce rate of fire and delay heat buildup in weapons.

effects.name: Fire Tornados
effects.role: Fire Tornados are an environmental condition that create occasional storms of Fire Tornados on Scorched Moor planets. which move slowly and (semi)randomly throughout the play area. An active Fire Tornado storm will activate the Intense Heat environmental...

effects.name: Intense Heat
effects.role: Intense Heat – Periods of high temperatures increase stamina drain and speed up heat buildup in weapons.

effects.name: Ion Storms
effects.role: Ion Storms – Ion storms intermittently disable Stratagems.

effects.name: Meteor Storms
effects.role: Meteor Storms – Meteors impact the surface causing massive damage.

effects.name: Rainstorms
effects.role: Rainstorms – Torrential rainstorms reduce visibility.

effects.name: Sandstorms
effects.role: Sandstorms – Dense sandstorms reduce mobility and greatly reduce visibility for both enemy and friendly units.

effects.name: Thick Fog
effects.role: Thick Fog – Dense fog lightly reduces visibility for both enemy and friendly units.

effects.name: Tremors
effects.role: Tremors – Frequent earthquakes stun players and enemies alike.

effects.name: Volcanic Activity
effects.role: Volcanic Activity – Volcanos throw burning rocks around this planet.

missions.name: Purge Hatcheries
missions.role: Purge Hatcheries is a Mission in Helldivers 2. To complete it, Helldivers must go to the Terminid Hatcheries and destroy most of the eggs present. It may also appear as an Optional Objective on Gloom covered planets.

missions.name: Sabotage Air Base

missions.name: Activate Oil Pumps
missions.role: Activate Oil Pumps is a Mission Objective in Helldivers 2. The target structure contains Explosive Barrels, Ammo Boxes, Samples, SEAF Communications Device, and Vending Machines.

missions.name: Activate TCS+ Station
missions.role: Activate TCS+ Station is a short Terminid Main Mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers are tasked with activating a TCS+ tower by defending its battery silos, in order to allow for the spread of Termicide 2.0 and mass Terminid culling.

missions.name: Activate Terminid Control System
missions.role: Activate Terminid Control System was a Mission Objective in Helldivers 2. It was available from March 12th to March 16th, 2024, as part of Phase III of Operation Valiant Enclosure.

missions.name: Annex Untapped Mineral Sites

missions.name: Blitz Search And Destroy/Automaton

missions.name: Blitz Search And Destroy/Terminid
missions.role: Blitz: Search and Destroy is a Mission in Helldivers 2. To complete the Objective, Helldivers must destroy a specific amount of Bug Holes, which changes with difficulty. Bug Holes consist of Terminid Nests, Shrieker Nests, and Stalker Lairs. Minor Place of...

missions.name: Blitz: Destroy Bio-Processors
missions.role: Blitz: Destroy Bio-Processors is a short main mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers are tasked with swiftly destroying a set amount of Bio-Processors on the map before the Super Destroyers must evac the airspace.

missions.name: Blitz: Destroy Illuminate Warp Gateways
missions.role: Blitz: Destroy Illuminate Warp Gateways is an Illuminate Mission in Helldivers 2 exclusive to the Void Source Planet. Helldivers are tasked with destroying a specific amount of Illuminate Warp Gateways, which changes with difficulty.

missions.name: Blitz: Destroy Illuminate Warp Ships
missions.role: Blitz: Destroy Illuminate Warp Ships is an Illuminate Mission in Helldivers 2. To complete it Helldivers must destroy a specific amount of grounded Illuminate Warp Ships which changes with difficulty.

missions.name: Blitz: Secure Research Site
missions.role: Blitz: Secure Research Site is a Gloom Expedition-exclusive main mission in Helldivers 2. Similar to other Blitz Missions, Helldivers must destroy a specific number of Bug Holes, the amount depending on the difficulty.

missions.name: Blitz: Suppress Toxic Pollination
missions.role: Blitz: Suppress Toxic Pollination is a short Illuminate Mission in Helldivers 2, exclusive to the Void. Helldivers are tasked with quickly destroying all Void Blossoms located on the map.

missions.name: Collect Gloom Spore Readings

missions.name: Collect Meteorological Data
missions.role: Collect Meteorological Data is a Mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers are tasked with retrieving a black box from a downed aircraft, then reactivating and uploading the data. The black box must be transported and delivered to complete the final objective.

missions.name: Commando: Acquire Evidence
missions.role: Commando: Acquire Evidence is an Automaton Commando Mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers are tasked with using a Tactical Video Camera to record multiple Automaton objects, and extracting with the evidence.

missions.name: Commando: Extract Intel
missions.role: Commando: Extract Intel is an Automaton Commando Mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers are tasked with acquiring an Automaton keycard in order to steal their high-value data cache.

missions.name: Commando: Secure Black Box
missions.role: Commando: Secure Black Box is an Automaton Commando Mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers are tasked with destroying surrounding Anti-Aircraft Emplacements, and extracting a Black Box from a downed SEAF aircraft.

missions.name: Conduct Geological Survey

missions.name: Conduct Mobile E-711 Extraction
missions.role: Conduct Mobile E-711 Extraction, previously known as Conduct Mobile Substance Extraction, is a Main Objective Mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers are tasked to locate, then drive the Ground All-Terrain Extraction Rig (GATER) to various different locations...

missions.name: Confiscate Assets
missions.role: Confiscate Assets is an Automaton Mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers are tasked with seizing valuable cargo within various Automaton Industrial Sites, such as Fusion Batteries and Platinum Bars.

missions.name: Deactivate Terminid Control System

missions.name: Democratize the Void
missions.role: Democratize the Void is an Illuminate Main Mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers are tasked with eliminating Monoliths and raising Super Earth flags across the map. It is currently only available on Void-consumed planets.

missions.name: Deploy Dark Fluid
missions.role: Deploy Dark Fluid is a Mission that was released during the Operation Enduring Peace event and was exclusive to the planet of Meridia, which was a Terminid Supercolony. Helldivers must call-in Dark Fluid Vessels and insert them into Tectonic Drills at three...

missions.name: Destroy Command Bunkers

missions.name: Destroy Exospire
missions.role: Destroy Exospire is an Illuminate mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers are tasked with extracting data from multiple Illuminate Ruins before terminating the Exospire's energy supply.

missions.name: Destroy Gazer Spire
missions.role: Destroy Gazer Spire is an Illuminate mission in Helldivers 2, exclusive to The Void. Helldivers are tasked with destroying multiple Gazer Spires located around the map. Each Gazer Spire structure is heavily guarded by Gazer sentries and Warp Gateways that...

missions.name: Destroy Harvesters
missions.role: Destroy Harvesters is a Mission Objective that can only appear on Illuminate controlled planets. To complete the Objective, Helldivers must destroy all marked Harvesters.

missions.name: Destroy Spore Lung
missions.role: Destroy Spore Lung is a Mission in Helldivers 2.

missions.name: Eliminate Automaton Hulks
missions.role: Eliminate Automaton Hulks is an Automaton Main Objective, and also a Optional Objective on special "Disrupt Socialist Industries" Operations. To complete the Objective, Helldivers must destroy all marked Hulks.

missions.name: Eliminate Bile Titans
missions.role: In this mission, the squad is in charge of finding and killing a Bile Titan.

missions.name: Eliminate Brood Commanders
missions.role: Eliminate Brood Commanders is a mission in Helldivers 2. To complete the objective, Helldivers must eliminate marked Brood Commanders. Dispatching other Brood Commmanders won't progress the mission.

missions.name: Eliminate Chargers
missions.role: Eliminate Chargers is a Mission in Helldivers 2. To complete the Objective, Helldivers must eliminate the specified Chargers. The targets will always be Charger Behemoths.

missions.name: Eliminate Devastators
missions.role: The Eliminate Devastators is a Mission Objective. To complete the Objective, Helldivers must destroy all marked Devastators.

missions.name: Eliminate Impaler
missions.role: Eliminate Impaler is a Mission in Helldivers 2. To complete the objective Helldivers must eliminate the specified Impalers

missions.name: Emergency Evacuation
missions.role: Emergency Evacuation is a Mission in Helldivers 2.

missions.name: Enable Oil Extraction
missions.role: Enable Oil Extraction is a Mission in Helldivers 2. To complete the objective, Helldivers must interact with the terminal, open valves, and oversee the fueling of transport ships.

missions.name: Eradicate Automaton Forces
missions.role: The Eradicate Automaton Forces is a Main Mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers must eliminate a large amount of enemies in a short period of time.

missions.name: Eradicate Illuminate Forces
missions.role: Eradicate Illuminate Forces is an Illuminate Main Mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers are tasked with eliminating a large amount of enemies in a short period of time.

missions.role: Eradicate Terminid Swarm is a Main Mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers are dropped into a small area, where they must kill a set number of enemies.

missions.role: Evacuate Colonists, or Evacuate Citizens in city missions, is a Mission in Helldivers 2.

missions.name: Extract E-711
missions.role: Extract E-711, previously known as Extract Mysterious Substance, is a Mission in Helldivers 2.

missions.name: Extract Research Probe Data
missions.role: Extract Research Probe Data is a Mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers are tasked with locating and boosting the upload signal to two or more research probes.

missions.name: Free Colony
missions.role: Free Colony, or Free the City in the Metropolis biome, is a mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers are tasked with destroying an Illuminate Monolith, and asserting Super Earth's presence in the area by raising its flag.

missions.name: Halt Cyborg Production
missions.role: Halt Cyborg Production is an Automaton Main Objective in Helldivers 2. This is a Megafactory only objective, in which Helldivers are tasked with destroying a Cyborg Production Unit by flooding, and detonating it with Hydrogen.

missions.name: Infiltrate Illuminate Lair
missions.role: Infiltrate Illuminate Lair is an Illuminate mission in Helldivers 2, exclusive to The Void. Helldivers are tasked with a set of randomized main objectives, some of which borrow from Destroy Gazer Spire and Blitz: Suppress Toxic Pollination.

missions.role: The Launch ICBM is a mission which tasks Helldivers to activate/retrieve various items/structures to launch an ICBM. At Medium it gains the "Retrieve Launch Codes" sub-objective, and at Hard it gains the "reactivate power" sub-objective. All sub-objectives...

missions.name: Neutralize Ground-to-Orbit Defenses
missions.role: Neutralize Ground-to-Orbit Defenses is a Mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers must destroy 2-3 Orbital Cannons around the map using Hellbombs.

missions.role: Nuke Nursery is a Mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers must locate 2-3 nursery chambers, call in the Hive Breaker Drill at each drill point, and then detonate the nuclear device that is drilled into the surface.

missions.name: Rapid Acquisition
missions.role: Rapid Acquisition is a short Automaton Main Mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers are tasked with rapidly collecting and extracting Platinum Bars in a heavily-guarded cache, with constant reinforcements trying to stop you.

missions.name: Repel Invasion Fleet

missions.name: Restart Pumps
missions.role: Restart Pumps is a Mission Objective in Helldivers 2. The target structure contains Explosive Barrels, Ammo Boxes, and Samples. This mission type is currently unavailable.

missions.name: Restore Air Quality
missions.role: Restore Air Quality is a Main Mission exclusive to Terminid Mega Cities. Helldivers are tasked with destroying Spore Spewers within the City.

missions.name: Retrieve Recon Craft Intel
missions.role: Retrieve Recon Craft Intel is a Main Mission in Helldivers 2, in which Helldivers are tasked with retrieving a Black Box from a down SEAF aircraft, and uploading the data.

missions.name: Retrieve Valuable Data
missions.role: The Retrieve Valuable Data is a Main Objective Mission in Helldivers 2. It tasks Helldivers to obtain an SSD Drive (either one or multiple), carry it to the main mission site, and upload it.

missions.name: Sabotage Orgo-Plasma Synthesis
missions.role: Sabotage Orgo-Plasma Synthesis is an Automaton Mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers are tasked with destroying various Bio-Processors, and extracting a sample of the nutrient-dense plasma.

missions.name: Sabotage Supply Bases
missions.role: The Sabotage Supply Bases is an Automaton Main Objective, and it's main objectives are also available as single Optional Objective on special "Disrupt Socialist Industries" and "Commando" Operations. On normal Liberation and Defense Operations, this mission...

missions.name: Seize Industrial Complex
missions.role: Seize Industrial Complex is an Automaton Mission in Helldivers 2. Helldivers are tasked with appropriating an Automaton Platinum Refinery, and on higher difficulties, annexing one or more nearby quarries.

missions.name: Spread Democracy
missions.role: The Spread Democracy is a Mission Objective in Helldivers 2 that can appear on both Terminid and Automaton controlled planets on all difficulties. The mission may also appear as an Optional Objective on Gloom covered planets.

missions.name: Start Fuel Pumps
missions.role: The Pump Fuel To ICBM is a Main Objective in Helldivers 2 that can appear on both Terminid and Automaton controlled planets.

missions.name: Take Down Overship
missions.role: Take Down Overship is a Mission which tasks Helldivers with retrieving various items in order to operate and fire an Planetary Defense Cannon capable of eliminating the Illuminate Overship.

missions.name: Upload Escape Pod Data
missions.role: Upload Escape Pod Data is a generic Main Objective on Trivial and Easy, and an Optional Objective on higher difficulties. It consists of a crashed escape pod. To complete the objective, Helldivers must upload its data while in close proximity to it.
